description: Settings for the Reno Order app

fields.description: Orders with a discount above this % can only be confirmed by a user with the approver role. 0 = no limit.
fields.label: Discount Approval Threshold (%)

fields.description: Background jobs create Delivery Notes as this user. Use a service account with the Stock User and Sales User roles. Empty = Administrator (fine for demos, not recommended in production).
fields.label: Automation User

fields.description: Off: the Delivery Note is prepared as a draft for the warehouse to check and submit. On: it is submitted straight away (stock leaves the warehouse).
fields.label: Submit Delivery Note Automatically

name: Reno Settings
